Answer: C
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a cystic lesion in the fetal right lower lung zone (adjacent to the diaphragm/heart) with visible systemic arterial supply on Doppler, characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or hybrid lesion; unlike large CPAMs, these typically do not cause significant mediastinal shift or diaphragmatic inversion, matching the description of an intact diaphragm and no shift.
